title: The Power of a Praying Parent
author: Stormie Omartian
target_audience: Individuals wishing to pray effectively for their children
Readers interested in Christian guidance on family life
core_themes: The transformative power of prayer in parenting
Trusting God with your children’s lives and futures
Seeking divine guidance for children’s physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being
Overcoming parenting anxieties by relying on faith
primary_purpose: To encourage and equip parents to pray consistently and specifically for their children, fostering both parental peace and spiritual growth in the family through scripturally-based prayer.

structure_format.organization: Composed of 30 short chapters, each focusing on a distinct area of a child's life to pray about, accompanied by sample prayers and relevant Bible verses
features: Sample prayers at the end of each chapter
Scripture references for each prayer focus
Space for personal notes or reflections (in some editions)

key_concepts_lessons: Prayer is a powerful tool for influencing a child’s development and safeguarding their well-being.
Trust in God is foundational for parents facing the worries and uncertainties of raising children.
Specific, targeted prayers can address every aspect of a child’s life—including health, friendships, safety, character, and faith.
Parents are called to intercede regularly for their children, regardless of age or circumstance.
Letting go of parental control and surrendering children’s outcomes to God brings peace.
Persistent, faith-filled prayer strengthens family relationships and parental confidence.
notable_features: 30 chapters covering diverse prayer topics for children
Each chapter includes practical, scripture-based sample prayers
Personal anecdotes from the author’s parenting journey
Widely used in Christian parenting communities and prayer groups
Features space for parents to personalize prayers
cultural_historical_context: First published in the mid-1990s, the book became a staple in Christian homes, reflecting a renewed movement toward intentional, prayer-centered parenting amid changing family dynamics and societal challenges.
reception_impact: International bestseller, translated into multiple languages
Established Stormie Omartian as a leading voice in faith-based prayer literature
Praised for its accessibility and practicality among diverse Christian denominations
Frequently used as a resource in churches, small groups, and family ministries
Critics note its denominational focus may limit appeal for non-Christian readers
comparable_titles: The Power of a Praying Wife by Stormie Omartian
Praying Circles Around Your Children by Mark Batterson
Prayers for the Faithful Parent by Brooke McGlothlin
